text: Target Corporation is listed on the NYSE (TGT); per its 2026 proxy statement, its two disclosed 5%+ shareholders are State Street Corporation (7.9%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.2%), among 11,675 shareholders of record. No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: Target Corporation, 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: each person or entity known to us to be the beneficial owner of more than five percent of our common stock
